component.name: Jimha
component.summary: Toddler-safe fullscreen interactive sensory key smash wonderland

description.p: Jimha is a next-generation adaptive sensory playground and toddler-safe fullscreen key smash game. Designed with extreme kiosk security, high-contrast spring typography, liquid floating bubbles, real-time DSP pentatonic chime synthesizers, multi-touch drumming, and Steam Deck controller integration.

ul.li: Toddler-safe lock: Swallows destructive system key combinations (Alt+F4, Ctrl+W, F5, F11, Escape).
Adult Esc hold gate: Requires holding Escape continuously for 3.0 seconds to exit.
Parent Alt+Tab gate: 2.0-second continuous hold with built-in Virtual Switcher carousel.
Steam Deck & Gamepad support: D-pad, ABXY buttons, and analog sticks with Konami code combos!
Multi-touch drumming & palm tap detection: Multi-bubble popping and celebratory particle bursts.
100% private, offline, zero-tracking child progression with unlockable milestone badges.

description.p: Phase 5 Major Release: Multi-Touch Multiplexer, Steam Deck Gamepad Integration, Linux Packaging (Flatpak & PKGBUILD), and Dual-Auditor Gate readiness.
